stem_book: A gun crew observes a remotely controlled balloon launching an instrumented spy package in enemy territory. When first noticed the balloon is at an altitude of 800 m and moving vertically upward at a constant velocity of 5 m/s, and is 1600 m away (horizontally). Shells fired from the gun have an initial velocity of 400 m/s at a fixed angle θ (sinθ = 3/5 and cosθ = 4/5). The gun crew waits and fires so as to destroy the balloon. Assume g = 10 m/s². Neglect air resistance. How long did the gun crew wait before they fired (in sec)? (a) 10 (b) 40 (c) 50 (d) 80
